examples: charged twice duplicate payment double charge money debited twice
refund missing invoice incorrect amount bill overcharged
subscription cancelled still billed payment deducted
plan: Compare the invoice with the payment ledger. Verify any duplicate entry before authorizing a refund.

examples: package never arrived order missing shipment delivery delayed
parcel tracking says delivered but nothing received
courier shipped to wrong address late delivery
plan: Check tracking scans and proof of delivery. Confirm the address through the order record before arranging a replacement.

examples: cannot log in locked out login account password reset
verification code otp never received sign in failed
password reset email expired login blocked
plan: Check the sign-in event and recovery channel. Use the verified account recovery process.

examples: app crashes freezes when opening dashboard error
website broken blank screen page fails to load
application slow outage service unavailable server down
plan: Collect the error message, app version and time. Reproduce the issue and verify the fix with the reporter.

examples: item arrived damaged cracked broken defective product
replacement needed faulty device stopped working
wrong size poor quality item received
plan: Confirm the product and defect with the reporter. Check replacement eligibility and record the agreed remedy.

account hacked suspicious login stolen credentials

plan: Route to a security reviewer and verify the reporter through an approved channel.
